summary: Measure value-chain losses, plan practical interventions, and build monitoring tools. Explore the five-day post-harvest loss reduction course.
lede: Post-harvest loss measurement and reduction helps value-chain professionals identify where food quantity or quality is lost after harvest or capture. For agribusiness, warehouse and aggregation managers, and food-security programme officers, it covers mapping loss points, calculating baseline losses, and comparing feasible interventions. Participants also develop handling controls and monitoring measures, considering the practical uses and limits of digital data capture and AI-assisted grading.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, manage, finance, or support post-harvest handling across food value chains.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge is not specified in the course brief. Practical exposure to agriculture, food handling, storage, logistics, processing, extension, or food-security programmes will help you connect the exercises to your work. No coding or programming is required.
